clause_text: In no event shall either party's cumulative liability under this Agreement exceed the total fees paid in the preceding twelve (12) months, or $100,000, whichever is less.
Either party may terminate this Agreement for any reason or no reason upon delivering sixty (60) days prior written notice to the other party.
Provider shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Client from and against any third-party claims, liabilities, losses, and damages arising out of Provider's gross negligence or willful misconduct.
Each party agrees to maintain in strict confidence all proprietary technical and business information disclosed by the other party for a period of five (5) years following disclosure.
This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and remain in effect for an initial period of two (2) years, renewing automatically for successive one (1) year terms unless terminated.
The Recipient shall hold all Confidential Information in confidence and shall not disclose such information to any third party without prior written authorization from Disclosing Party.
Except for breaches of confidentiality obligations, neither party shall be liable for indirect, incidental, punitive, or consequential damages.
The term of confidentiality shall expire three (3) years from the date of initial disclosure of the applicable Confidential Information.
Disclosing Party may terminate discussions and demand return of all proprietary materials with seven (7) days written notice.

Employee agrees that during employment and for a period of twelve (12) months following termination, Employee shall not directly or indirectly engage in or operate any competing business within a 50-mile radius.
Employee shall not at any time, during or after employment, use or disclose Employer's proprietary customer lists, trade secrets, or source code.
Employer may terminate Employee's employment at will, with or without cause, provided Employer gives thirty (30) days written notice or pay in lieu thereof.
Employer agrees to indemnify Employee to the maximum extent permitted by applicable law for actions performed within the scope of regular employment duties.
Consultant agrees to indemnify and hold harmless Company from any claims, damages, or fines arising from Consultant's failure to comply with statutory tax obligations.
In no event shall Company be liable for lost profits, loss of data, or special damages, and total liability shall be capped at $25,000.
During the term and for six (6) months thereafter, Consultant shall not solicit any active clients of Company whom Consultant worked with directly.
All deliverables and proprietary market analyses generated under this statement of work remain strictly confidential Company property.
Either party may terminate any ongoing Statement of Work with fourteen (14) days advance notice in writing.
This agreement shall be valid for a duration of one (1) year from signature and may be renewed by mutual written amendment.
Tenant shall have the right to early terminate this Lease after Month 24 upon giving ninety (90) days advance written notice and paying a penalty fee of $15,000.
Landlord's liability for any default or damage under this lease shall be strictly limited to Landlord's equity interest in the leased commercial building.
Tenant covenants to indemnify and hold Landlord harmless against any slip-and-fall injuries, damages, or liabilities occurring within the premises.
Tenant is granted an option to renew the lease for an additional term of thirty-six (36) months by written notice delivered at least 180 days prior to expiration.
Neither partner shall establish, finance, or advise an entity operating in direct competition with the Joint Venture for two (2) years following dissolution.
Both partners agree not to disclose financial records, audit findings, or intellectual property without unanimous written consent.
Each partner shall indemnify the partnership for liabilities incurred as a result of unauthorized commitments made outside specified authority.
Liability between partners for operational errors shall be capped at each partner's respective initial capital contribution of $200,000.
Either partner may exit the partnership upon providing one hundred eighty (180) days advance notice to initiate orderly asset liquidation.
The partnership term shall run for five (5) years from the Effective Date.
